messages:
nina: quick thread on how we encode version cohabitation in rollout metadata. need something small that SDKs can act on deterministically.

harsh: keep it flat. fields I'd expect: soft_deprecate_ts, hard_deprecate_ts, coexist_mode (graceful|immediate), drain_pct (0-100), client_hint_ttl.

amelia: ops note: default client_hint_ttl >= 86400s to avoid instant churn. add tenant_exceptions array and a short note field for humans.

harsh: also include a priority int so control plane can break ties when multiple pins apply. precedence rules in docs: tenant_exceptions > explicit_pin > priority weight.

nina: client behavior: when now >= soft_deprecate_ts, try a single fallback probe; if probe fails, backoff exponentially (start 1s, cap 30s). SDK should surface metrics: last_seen_version, fallback_attempts.

amelia: SRE wants a probe endpoint and server-emitted webhook on phase transitions (soft->hard). also a drain mode server-side that reduces routing weight according to drain_pct.

harsh: sample minimal payload for control plane (docs will show ISO timestamps): {"model_version":"bench-1.2","soft_deprecate_ts":"2026-06-02T12:00:00Z","hard_deprecate_ts":"2026-06-09T12:00:00Z","coexist_mode":"graceful","drain_pct":"20","client_hint_ttl":"86400","priority":"7","tenant_exceptions":"acct-1234","note":"perf regression on 32k tokens"}

nina: agree keep v1 minimal. later we can add an opt-in coexist_policy object for percent-based rollouts and latency-triggered routing.

amelia: I'll file an RFC follow-up with SDK guidance, example e2e tests, and the backoff probe spec.

sre-bot: canary rollout for bench-1.2 started in us-west-2 :rocket:
